features.name: Context health and CI drift gate

features.evidence: User-reported npm test: 19 files passed, 817 tests passed

features.name: Playground and focused feedback
features.behavior: Provides a populated example and opens a short prefilled feedback issue at value moments

features.name: Lightweight drift automation

features.evidence: Maintainer decision on 2026-07-02: existing status and CI drift checks are sufficient; no additional automation needed

features.name: Distribution experiment
